code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# install: brew install watchexec  or  cargo install watchexec-cli

watchexec \
  --exts {{watch_ext}} \
  --ignore '**/node_modules/**' \
  --ignore '**/.git/**' \
  --ignore '**/dist/**' \
  --debounce 300ms \
  --clear \
  --restart \
  -- {{command}}
summary_zh: watchexec 含 debounce ignore 自動跑命令
